title: Case: Pickup locker is full
context: The destination locker has no free compartment. The carrier needs to offer a viable alternate, then confirm readiness after the recipient chooses.
initial_request: I need the parcel before the locker retry date. Please send me the carrier’s alternative collection option.

events.body:
DL-8775 cannot be placed in Copperfin Locker because all suitable compartments are occupied. The parcel remains in depot stock. We can offer staffed Sedgeglass Counter or retry the locker after two days.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-124.txt
I need the parcel before the locker retry date. Please send me the carrier’s alternative collection option.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier to offer an available alternative collection location to the recipient.

must_not: An accepted alternative alone is not readiness; this case has an actual counter scan. Collection remains open.
Treats label-scan-124.txt as evidence about DL-8775: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-13358)
Tells anyone that DL-8775 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-124.txt
expected.reference_message: Please offer Eamon the available staffed Sedgeglass Counter option through the verified order thread and obtain their choice before routing DL-8775.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-016: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-124.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-13358); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
